New 5G smartphones with large batteries launched and announced

Several new 5G smartphones featuring large batteries have been launched or announced by various manufacturers. The POCO M8 Power, equipped with an 8,000mAh battery and a Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 SoC, has been launched in India. Other upcoming devices include a Redmi phone with an 8,000mAh battery, a Realme 16x 5G with a 7,000mAh battery and 144Hz display, and a Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro 5G. Motorola is also expected to release a new 5G phone with a Snapdragon processor and a 50MP camera.
